title: Down Home Creole spice plant: Phase 1 prototype
summary: A 2,000 sq ft blended-seasoning plant for 1,000 lb a week on one shift, launching with 5 blends and laid out for all 13. Ingredients are dosed from 9 stainless bins (12 positions) into a weigh hopper and blended in a used 6 cu ft ribbon blender, sieved, held for QC, then hand-packed on a semi-automatic bench with metal detection and checkweighing. 82.5 % of blend weight is dosed automatically. Stainless frames, bins, hoppers, chutes and tables are fabricated in house to save money; scales, feeders, the metal detector and the filler are bought.

assembly.title: Prepare the rooms and mark the layout
assembly.text: Before any equipment: sealed epoxy floor with coved base in the two Z3 rooms, washable ceiling, 208 V 3-phase and 120 V circuits per the layout, hand sink at the vestibule. Snap the equipment outlines from drawing DH-LAY-P1 (1:50) onto the floor.
assembly.check: every outline matches DH-LAY-P1 within 25 mm [1 in]; 900 mm [36 in] aisles clear

assembly.title: Receiving and storage
assembly.text: Set the floor scale with its ramp at the receiving door and level it. Build the six NSF shelving units 6 in off the floor and 18 in from walls.
assembly.check: floor scale reads a 50 lb test weight within 0.2 lb

assembly.title: Anchor the bin ring frame
assembly.text: Stand the ring frame on its marks, shim the foot plates level and anchor each with 1/2 in wedge anchors, 3 in embed. Seal the foot plates to the floor with food-grade silicone.
assembly.check: ring top level within 2 mm across

assembly.title: Mount the load cells and weigh hopper
assembly.text: Bolt the three weigh modules to the frame brackets, lower the hopper onto them, fit the 4 in butterfly valve on the outlet Tri-Clamp. Nothing but the flexible boots may touch the hopper.
assembly.check: hopper rocks freely on the cells; nothing bridges to the frame

assembly.title: Hang the bins, feeders and level probes
assembly.text: Bolt each bin to its ring position with M12 bolts, the feeder to the bin outlet flange with an FDA gasket, and a BFM flexible connector from each feeder spout to its hopper inlet. Fit a Soliphant in each bin's low-level port. Bins B01 to B09 in the order of dosing-plan.md (salt, garlic, paprika, onion, black pepper, coarse black pepper, cayenne, lemon peel, red pepper); positions 10 to 12 stay blanked for growth.
assembly.torque: M10 outlet flange 25 N·m; M12 bin lugs 70 N·m
assembly.check: every connector sits square; tag each bin with its ingredient label

assembly.title: Flexible screw and blender
assembly.text: Set the used blender on its marks and level it. Fit the bag-dump grate in the cover opening and the discharge chute to the outlet valve. Run the flexible screw from under the hopper valve to the blender inlet, supported at its midpoint.
assembly.check: blender inspected: ribbons clear the trough by 3 to 6 mm, shaft seals tight, cover interlock works

assembly.title: Sieve deck, magnet and drum dollies
assembly.text: Stand the sieve deck under the chute, seat the 12 mesh screen on its ledge with the 4 quick clamps, bolt the vibrator to the leg frame and drop the grate magnet into the outlet. Build the three drum dollies with their casters.
assembly.check: screen seals all round; magnet pull test card picks up

assembly.title: Weigh bench, hood and premix tumbler
assembly.text: Place the weigh bench, bolt the backdraft hood to its back edge, set the two Mettler scales and the label printer, and set the tumbler on the bench end.
assembly.check: both scales level (bubble) and calibrated with test weights

assembly.title: Dust collection
assembly.text: Set the collector on its outside pad and run 4 in ducts to the weigh hood (300 cfm), weigh hopper vent (150 cfm), blender grate (250 cfm) and sieve (200 cfm), with a blast gate at each.
assembly.check: measured airflow at each pickup within 10 % of its design value; total under the collector's 1,150 cfm

assembly.title: Pack bench
assembly.text: Line up the four stainless tables, then fill, cap, seal, label, metal detect, checkweigh and case pack in that order, with the turntable at the end. Fit the printed container nests under the filler and the cap grips at the capping table.
assembly.check: metal detector rejects the Fe 1.5, non-Fe 2.0 and SS 2.5 mm test pieces in the leading, middle and trailing position

assembly.title: Controls and wiring
assembly.text: Mount the WAGO panel and the nine GS20 drives, wire feeders, probes, valve, screw and the 880 indicator per DosingStation.st's I/O declaration. E-stops and the hopper and screw guards go through the safety relay, not the PLC. A licensed electrician does the power wiring.
assembly.check: every I/O point toggles on the PLC watch list; e-stop drops all drives

assembly.title: MES computer and commissioning
assembly.text: Install the MES (software/mes) on the Dell, start it with --blender P1-301, assign B01 to B09 and load the first lots. Calibrate the hopper, tune the dosing in-flight, then run the acceptance tests below.
assembly.check: all acceptance tests pass and are signed

firmware.check: watch list shows Dose_Step = IDLE; HOLD alarms clear with HMI_Reset

firmware.name: Plant MES
firmware.check: http://<mes-pc>:8080 shows Ingredient bins, Blend batches and Pack runs

tests.name: Weigh hopper calibration
steps: add 20 kg, then 40 kg of test weight at each load-cell corner
tests.expect: reads within ±20 g at every corner and load

tests.name: Dose accuracy per bin
steps: dose each bin's largest planned target 5 times (dosing-plan.md)
record the hopper weight after settle
tests.expect: every dose within ±1 % (20 g minimum); in-flight learned and stable

tests.name: No-flow and bin-low holds
steps: run a feeder with its bin empty
tests.expect: NO FLOW alarm within 8 s; BIN LOW stops the step

tests.name: Blend uniformity
steps: pull 10 samples top, middle and bottom

tests.name: Metal detector (CCP-1)
steps: pass each test piece in leading, middle and trailing position, 3 times
tests.expect: every pass rejected into the locked bin

tests.name: Net contents (NIST HB 133)
steps: fill 30 units of each launch size
tests.expect: average ≥ declared; no unit short by more than the MAV

tests.name: Traceability drill
tests.expect: every batch and pallet found in under 2 hours

tests.name: Food-safety design checks
tests.expect: zoning, sanitary, dust airflow, shared equipment all PASS
